name: chordleaf
description: A local-first workspace for lyrics, guitar chords and printable rehearsal sheets.

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts build server api vercel.json vite.config.js docs *.md index.html package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts build server api vercel.json vite.config.js docs *.md index.html package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm test && SITE_URL=https://chordleaf.com pnpm build && pnpm check:metadata
